candidates.statement: Order service postgres connection pool is exhausted (size 5, idle 0), so save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable, order returns 503, and gateway checkout returns 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle come from trace attributes only; no pool saturation metric or postgres-side evidence was admitted.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 preceded by order ReadTimeout, order 503 from postgres save_order DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0; order metrics show 13.5/min 503s on /v1/orders. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; pool saturation metrics and logs are still needed to confirm.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool saturation/wait metrics for order service
Order service logs confirming pool acquisition timeouts
Postgres server-side connection and error metrics
